prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children doing a gentle body movement game, hands raised and feet stepping. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Body Song". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Head and hair, face and eye.
Ear and mouth, look very high.
Lip and tooth, neck and skin.
Arm and hand, make the game begin.
Finger, leg, one foot below.
Move the body, slow, slow, slow.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
